opening.function_rails: copied exactly from the unified opening template; not scaled
opening.body_alignment: garment needles 0-12 occupy columns 3-15; opening frames/pads are extra columns; body frame columns 2 and 16 are 13, and the other body side cells stay 0
opening.bind: opening rows do not bind to the stitch mesh

rules.back_direction: new row, B12→B1 around the back
rules.row_turn: 本表主体每一行都是 ccw，没有短行折返。矩阵里的 11/12 规则未改；开头行不含 11/12。
rules.palette_source: SingaLab single-knitting-compiler dependence/datfile.py getDefaultPalette, displayed with func_tiffany.py byte-swap
rules.knit_frames: 每一编织行的编织部分前后紧邻一格为 13。主体 14 行的 13 在边框列 2 与 16，工作列 3-15 不变。开头 11–12 为操作行，不加 13。
